insight.headline: Multiple Tracking Numbers
insight.what_changed: The `orderCreate` mutation in the GraphQL Admin API now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment. This is achieved by adding a `trackingNumbers` field to the `OrderCreateFulfillmentInput` object. The update allows for more accurate and detailed tracking information when importing orders.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the `orderCreate` mutation to import orders should update their code to utilize the new `trackingNumbers` field. This may involve modifying the fulfillment input to include multiple tracking numbers. It's essential to test the updated code to ensure compatibility and correct functionality. The GraphQL Admin API documentation should be consulted for the latest information on the `orderCreate` mutation and the `OrderCreateFulfillmentInput` object.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from more accurate and detailed tracking information, which can improve their overall shipping and fulfillment experience. This update can also help merchants better manage their orders and inventory.
insight.why_it_matters: This update matters because it provides more flexibility and accuracy in tracking orders, which is crucial for merchants and their customers. It also demonstrates Shopify's commitment to improving its APIs and developer tools.

recap.headline: Hydrogen and GraphQL Admin API updates dominate the week

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Hydrogen developer preview update adds new capabilities, including Vue bindings, and Oxygen is now available on development stores. The @shopify/cli-hydrogen and @shopify/mini-oxygen packages have been updated with patch changes.

themes.title: GraphQL Admin API Enhancements
themes.detail: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, and new fields are available for cash management activities and drawers in POS. Additionally, the Customer object in Shopify Functions now includes a createdAt field.

themes.title: Ecosystem and App Updates
themes.detail: The shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement, and merchants can see partner details on collaborator requests. The Shopify CLI has been updated to version 4.6.0, removing deprecated features and adding new flags.
